title: webflow_create_cms_item.input
description: Input for the Webflow CMS create-item publishing tool. WRITE/publishing-category: approval required. fieldData carries the item fields; isDraft defaults true (never auto-publish).

fieldData.description: The CMS item field values (e.g. name, slug, ...).

isDraft.description: Stage as draft; defaults true so writes never auto-publish.
